main_body: Two stacked wooden crates; the large left crate has a striped plank lid and a dark braced front face
top_band: rows 1-8 light tan plank lid (L 113/146 alternating stripes) at x=7 and x=15; row 9 dark edge (L44); front face rows 10-17 (L65)
evidence: The column scan at x=15 shows a clearly lighter top of 8 rows (L 113-146) over a dark 1-row edge (L44), then a much darker front face (L65) of 8 rows, a step of about 80 L. The top is a real horizontal surface about as tall as the front, so it is not a rim or a front elevation. The dark row 9 acts as the front edge and eave shadow. The brace on the front is painted flat rather than inset, but the main-body structure matches the 3/4 box in the guide. The smaller crate on the right follows the same construction.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 6 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. The lid is two alternating tan stripes and the front is one brown with a single diagonal brace line, so each material has only 2-3 steps. There is no grain, no nail dots and no per-plank variation. The outlines are tinted dark brown (12% neutral) and the flat-fill coverage is low at 9%, but these do not make up for the shallow shading and low information density next to the stall and well references.
